risk: Headcount grows outside approved plan and roles are filled without establishment approval, inflating cost.
audit_objective: Confirm headcount is controlled against approved establishment and budget.
what_to_review: Establishment approval and vacancy authorisation
Reconciliation of actual headcount to approved positions
Use of contractors to circumvent headcount limits
Backfill versus new role approval
Organisational change and restructuring authorisation
procedures: Reconcile paid headcount to approved establishment by function and investigate excesses.
Test whether contractor engagement increased where headcount was frozen.
Test a sample of hires to vacancy approval and budget availability.
Test restructuring costs against approvals.
red_flags: Contractor numbers rising as headcount is capped

risk: Hiring decisions are made without competitive or objective process, admitting unsuitable people and creating discrimination exposure.
audit_objective: Confirm recruitment is fair, documented and free from undisclosed conflicts.
what_to_review: Advertising, shortlisting and interview documentation
Panel composition and independence
Conflict of interest and relative disclosure by hiring managers
Use of agencies, their terms and fees
Consistency of offers against approved salary bands
procedures: Test a sample of hires for documented selection rationale and panel involvement.
Match new hires against employee records for family or prior relationships with the hiring manager.
Recompute agency fees against agreed terms and test rebate claims where hires leave early.
Test offers against approved salary bands and approval of exceptions.
red_flags: Relatives of employees appointed with no disclosure

risk: Staff perform regulated or safety-critical roles without the required competence, exposing the organisation to harm and enforcement.
audit_objective: Confirm role-required competence and mandatory training are achieved and current.
what_to_review: Identification of roles with mandatory training or certification requirements
Completion tracking and enforcement
Currency of certifications and expiry monitoring
Effectiveness assessment beyond attendance
Training records for contractors performing regulated work
procedures: Reconcile staff in regulated or safety-critical roles to completed and current certification.
Test enforcement — what happens when training lapses; if nothing, the control does not exist.
Test whether contractors in equivalent roles meet the same requirements.
Assess whether competence is tested or attendance merely recorded.
red_flags: Certifications expired but staff still rostered
Completion tracked with no consequence for non-completion

risk: Grievances and disciplinary matters are handled inconsistently, generating legal claims and eroding trust.
audit_objective: Assess whether employee relations cases are handled fairly, consistently and promptly.
what_to_review: Case logging, ownership and timeliness
Investigation independence, particularly for senior subjects
Consistency of outcomes for comparable conduct
Legal claims, settlements and their causes
Trends by manager, function and location
procedures: Review a sample of cases for procedural fairness and timeliness against policy.
Compare outcomes for comparable conduct across seniority levels and locations.
Analyse claims and settlements for recurring causes and whether root causes were addressed.
Analyse case volumes by manager for concentration.
red_flags: Different outcomes for the same conduct
Settlements with non-disclosure and no root cause work

risk: Pay and progression differ across comparable roles without justification, creating legal exposure and reputational risk.
audit_objective: Assess whether pay and progression decisions are equitable and defensible.
what_to_review: Pay analysis across comparable roles by gender and other protected characteristics
Progression and promotion rates across groups
Starting salary determination and negotiation effects
Reporting obligations on pay gaps
Action taken on identified disparities
procedures: Analyse pay for comparable roles and test the explanations offered for material dispersion.
Analyse promotion and progression rates across groups.
Test whether starting salaries are set by band or by negotiation, which tends to embed disparity.
Test the accuracy of any published pay gap reporting.
red_flags: Disparities explained as "experience" with no data
Starting salaries set entirely by negotiation
Published figures that cannot be reconstructed

subprocess: Employee Data Privacy and HR Systems
risk: Employee personal data is over-retained, over-shared or accessible to people with no business need.
audit_objective: Confirm employee data is protected, minimised and retained lawfully.
what_to_review: Access to HR and payroll data by role
Retention of records for leavers and unsuccessful candidates
Sharing with benefit providers, insurers and other third parties
Special category data — health, background checks
Monitoring of employees and its lawful basis
procedures: Test who can access sensitive employee data and whether the access is justified by role.
Test retention by identifying leaver and candidate records past the retention period.
Reconcile third parties receiving employee data to agreements and lawful basis.
Test the basis and transparency of any employee monitoring.
red_flags: Managers with access to the whole workforce record
Health data stored in general HR folders
Monitoring introduced without notice to staff

risk: Critical roles have no identified successor, so a departure creates immediate operational and control failure.
audit_objective: Assess whether key person dependency is identified and mitigated.
what_to_review: Identification of critical roles and single points of dependency
Succession plans and their realism
Documentation and cross-training for critical activities
Retention risk for key individuals
Handover quality when key staff leave
procedures: Identify critical roles and test whether a named, ready successor exists.
Test whether critical processes are documented sufficiently for another person to perform them.
Review recent departures of key staff and assess the quality of handover.
Assess whether mandatory leave is applied in roles where it would surface concealment.
red_flags: Succession plans naming the same person for several roles
